title: Activity Levels Across CPAT, SISEPUEDE, CBAM and FTT
subtitle: One driver layer so four climate models can be linked
message: Four models used for climate-fiscal work build activity in incompatible ways. One constant-elasticity rule over ten activities, driven by population, income and the cost of the energy service, puts them on one baseline and counts the price response once.

problem.title: Four models, four baselines

stats.label: descriptions of road transport inside CPAT, not consistent
FTT regions without car data, including Kenya

problem.text: Linked naively, the models give a ministry four GDP paths and a carbon price whose demand response is counted once, twice or not at all. SISEPUEDE and FTT have no price response; CPAT has one for every fuel.

mechanism.title: Cars grow much faster than travel
mechanism.caption: Stylized: population +1% and income per person +2% a year for ten years.
points: Ten activities, one rule, one base year, one set of forecasts.
Apply the price term only where the receiving model has none.
Cap the vehicle chain so car travel stays inside total travel.

action.title: Link the models with one layer
results: A 20% rise in driving cost cuts car use about 5%.
Population exponent moves cement and electricity by a few percent.
Heavy-industry output elasticities are judgment values.
